reference: only original train grt rows; per-interval piecewise-linear width interpolation of D; maximum train same-path H; no old test labels
clock_representation: round upward to grid, then canonical OpenSTA binary32 clock representation; require unchanged internal clock and stable four-decimal serialization of clock and proportional IO; advance grid only for numeric representability before measurement
packing_order: split, capture_fanout, reference_delay, width, interval; same RTL bundle across all targets; shared relative target uses maximum H+k*D of its intervals
duplicate_targets: one actual measurement with all declared target roles retained; no repeated-row inflation
baseline_training: only widest common absolute SDC 2250 rows
acquisition_order: collect loose2250 training and all validation first; if every grt interval passes after frozen reserve, freeze baseline selection and leave other training targets unmeasured by protocol; otherwise collect the preregistered remaining training targets once and compare baseline/conditional candidates; independent test always waits for validated frozen selection
calibration: for each candidate max(1, validation actual/predicted, train W16 cross-fit actual/predicted from W8/W32) * 1.05; no test labels; same feature family in cross-fit
selection: evaluate original validation gates after reserve; prefer eligible baseline family, then normalized MAE and serialized complexity; conditional family only if no baseline candidate is eligible for that quantity
quality_scope: every interval class and stage; keep synth/grt outcomes separate; no aggregate rescue
actual_target_feasibility: also report local QD+observed H versus actual target; observed H is evaluation evidence only, not a model input; whole setup/hold reported separately
reference_pressure_bound: deployment lower pressure is max over fitting width/load groups of their smallest sampled pressure; upper target2250; numerical/width/template/load relationships jointly enforced
independence_claim: new capture-load/source/target contexts at exposed widths20/28, not unseen-width generalization
execution_context: Deployment, new train, validation and independent test use four threads per tool. Exactly the sealed 43 completed two-thread baseline training runs may be inherited; no two-thread validation/test. Thread controls are explicitly allowed training variation, not assumed numerical invariance. Same-input thread diagnostics are excluded from fitting; original gates and independent four-thread test determine release.

thread_diagnostics.purpose: measure actual 2-to-4 thread effect on representative large bundles; not an all-circuit equality proof
